purpose: Resolve the existing R1-R9 evidence chain and expose advisory-quality evaluation only when the chain is complete.

requiredEvidence.p01: signal identity supplied by the authoritative advisory
requiredEvidence.notification: R8 notification causal evidence from the O05 notification evidence source

validation.identity: Every candidate must exactly match signalId, symbol, direction, signalTime, strategyId, and strategyVersion from P01.
validation.provenance: R1 candidate validation is authoritative for canonical payload, sourceRef, schemaVersion, contentHash, evidenceHash, idempotencyKey, timestamp authority, and append-only fields.
validation.pitAndCausality: informationAsOf <= signalTime <= capturedAt; notification observedAt and review timestamps must also satisfy the frozen causal contract.
validation.logicalIdentity: Each required snapshot artifact, notification observation, review event, evidenceId, and idempotencyKey must be unique; contradictory terminal payloads are NOT_EVALUABLE.
validation.notification: Notification disposition is derived only from R8/O05 claim and terminal evidence. Same terminal identity with a different terminal payload is not a replay.
validation.humanReview: Human-review completeness and unnecessaryAlert are derived only from persisted R9 REVIEW_STARTED and explicit REVIEW_SUBMITTED labels.
validation.failClosed: Missing, mismatched, duplicated, corrupt, non-canonical, forbidden, PIT-invalid, causally-invalid, or unreadable evidence returns NOT_EVALUABLE.
